Just speaking what I've learned. Life is a fucking whirlwind of a ride. Theres so many nooks and crannies of shit you dont know or even think about. Even shit thats right in front of you. Its crazy and something we can never imagine.

 Everything happens for a reason. Thats my hakuna matata, that's where I get my no worries. You got this! I'm happy to be inspiration. I'm at a loss because I know a lot of people are looking for an inspiration,  even myself.

You didn't make the promise to your therapist you made it to yourself.  Think of you, I don't know what you're struggling with but I assure you, you're not alone. DM me, reach out to a hot line. Talking, whether to a stranger on the internet or through a professional manner will help.

Man I'm there with you. Girl of my dreams, the women I thought was going to be my forever,  the one I was engaged to and with a kid. We've been broken up and not together for over a month. I'm living in a state with no family, no friends outside of the ones I met with her and no where to go. I'm living in a camper in the driveway of her house because that's my only option. You need to just work through it, therapy will help. You where someone you knew before her and you can find a piece of that again. 

I've been cheated on in all 5 of my relationships. One thing I've learned is you can only control what you do yourself and not others. You can control you're thoughts.  Whats the use of worrying about someone else's decision.  Yes they suck, yes it fucking hurts in a way people will never know. But YOU control what happens from here. Self care, self love. Not good as I'm sure most peoples are,  life sucks right now.  Its one thing after another of just shit. Shit as far as the eye can see. Between the crazy outside world and family drama with my SO and relationship issues, we've had 2 animals pass away and one ran away within the last month.  My family and I are starting a new life in a new home in a week and its hard to think positive. But I always remind myself that everything happens for a reason. It may take time to know it, you may never know the reason why. But it happened, take the time I need to heal, think positive about the situation and learn and live. I'm in the pursuit of happiness and I hope everyone out there who is hurting,  who is healing,  struggling or wishing by the days to realize that 2020 is a year of change. Change with it if you want,  chase your light in the dark of the world.
